items.title: Somalia: The Killer Who Was Also a Journalist — And the Method That Didn't Die With Him

items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, AUG 28 - After days of speculation, Portugal winger Rafael Leao on Friday made his choice and will leave AC Milan for Galatasaray, preferring the Turkish club to Premier League outfit Aston Villa. The Portuguese, after days of intense negotiations with the Turks and Villa, ultimately chose the former. AC Milan had already reached an agreement to sell him for approximately €45 million.
